comment: Mirrors that fail the automatic sign-in, and what the error must say. answers maps a host to the status and testdata page its sign-in form answers with; other hosts refuse the connection. Every error must also carry always.
always: copy the aa_account_id2 value into ANNAS_ACCOUNT_COOKIE

cases.name: every mirror refuses
reasons: annas-archive.gl put the sign-in form behind a DDoS-Guard browser check
annas-archive.gd answered the sign-in form with HTTP status 200 but no session
